method: Identical benchmark source and deterministic 1K/10K/100K shapes as baseline; fresh-process first query and same-process second query, three scripted generations, full immutable snapshots and both global-chain checks. Prior baseline and candidate are sequential runs, not randomized interleaving. No OS cache eviction; tmpfs; source store SHA checked after every pair.
limitations: Process-cold is a first request in a fresh test process, not a cold physical disk; OS caches are not evicted.

Time includes Cobra command construction/flags, scope, readonly SQLite snapshots, full chain verification, projection, query and JSON serialization; excludes OS process launch and post-response JSON assertions.
All three Generate calls are scripted. No real provider/network latency, token or cost claim.
Snapshot-open and validated-scan measurements are separate warm component observations after each pair, not additive decomposition of a query.
Candidate pipeline includes resolver decode, Retrieve, excerpts and selection prompt compilation, not pure search alone.
RSS is sampled every 5ms; process HWM is cumulative within each pair; sampled RSS includes retained Go heap.
One branch/team, compact deterministic terminal task results; no claim about arbitrary payloads, branch counts or physical-storage SLO.

Before/after samples were collected at different times on a shared host; latency differences are observations, not a causally isolated hardware experiment. Allocation reductions primarily reflect source changes.

sandbox_attempt.reason: Existing localhost TCP fixtures failed with socket: operation not permitted. Retained separately; complete gates rerun with local socket permission.

docs.summary: check-docs: 109 active files, 207 total files, 707 relative links, and 51 Go function anchors are valid

independent_statistics.scope: Manually recomputed p50/p95/min/max from all raw samples, validated successful result/event counts, unchanged benchmark/production hashes and immutable baseline JSON SHA.

resource_accounting.note: Shared cache totals include pre-existing dependencies, earlier projects and configured GOTMPDIR; net growth is not an ownership estimate. Removed archive is proven by task-introduced test body and obsolete invalid-fixture constants; preserved current normal/race archives and all unproven shared artifacts. Private binary and all benchmark fixtures are gone; retained only small logs, raw measurements, scripts and recovery manifests.
